full_text_en:
Sun Xianlu v. — hijacking of aircraft case

Defendant: Sun Xianlu, male, 25 years old, formerly a worker at Tianjin No. 2 Steel Plant, arrested on December 14, 1993.

The Nanjing People's Procuratorate of Jiangsu Province instituted a public prosecution against the defendant Sun Xianlu for the crime of hijacking an aircraft before the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court.

The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court, after trial, found the following facts: From July 1993, the defendant Sun Xianlu began preparing for the criminal offense of hijacking an aircraft. On November 26, 1993, Sun Xianlu purchased a ticket from Tianjin to Shanghai. At 2:00 p.m. on November 28 of the same year, Sun Xianlu boarded China International Airlines Flight 1523, a Boeing 737 bearing registration number B-258, carrying a gunpowder package and ignition wire that he had prepared earlier. Shortly after takeoff, Sun Xianlu threatened to detonate the gunpowder package, coercing the crew to fly to Taiwan, and said to the crew: "My explosives are real; if you don't go, I will blow up the plane immediately." After the crew took measures, Sun Xianlu was arrested at Nanjing Airport.

The above facts are confirmed by the testimony of witnesses Huang Fang, Wang Xiaoming, Jin Xiaozi, Wu Xiaogang, Li Lingjie, Hu Mingbo, and Zhao Changjin. The physical evidence includes gunpowder, ignition wire, and matches seized at the scene, which the defendant Sun Xianlu identified in court as items he had brought. The gunpowder carried by Sun Xianlu was identified as black powder through forensic scientific and technical examination. Sun Xianlu confessed to the above facts.

The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court held that the defendant Sun Xianlu, through meticulous premeditation, hijacked an aircraft by means of threatening to detonate gunpowder, seriously disrupting normal aviation order and endangering the lives and property of passengers. His conduct constituted the crime of hijacking an aircraft as stipulated in the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Punishing Criminals Who Hijack Aircraft, and he should be severely punished with life imprisonment; in accordance with Article 53, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, Sun Xianlu shall be deprived of political rights for life. Accordingly, on January 13, 1994, the court rendered the following judgment:

The defendant Sun Xianlu is convicted of the crime of hijacking an aircraft and sentenced to life imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for life.

After the first-instance judgment was announced, the defendant Sun Xianlu did not appeal within the statutory time limit, and the procuratorial authority did not lodge a protest. The criminal judgment of the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court became legally effective.
